Fluxive: The central AI platform for building agentic workflows.
Neural: Relating to a nerve or the nervous system, often used in AI to describe networks.
ILE: Integrated Learning Environment - a unified interface for active learning.
Agent: An autonomous entity capable of perceiving its environment and acting upon it.
Module: A distinct unit of coursework focusing on a specific topic.
Artifact: A digital object created or used during the learning process.
RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation - combining LLMs with external data retrieval.
